definitions.first_lexical_divergence: First actual full-stream token mismatch or stream ending; BOS has index 0. Includes structural tokens and exact procedure names. No EOS is inserted or removed.
definitions.first_wrong_comparable_selected_role: Earliest generated token index with MATCHED correspondence, LEGAL mapped expected choice, observed generated choice, and correct=false under the frozen matcher.
definitions.no_wrong_comparable: Not success: missing, changed-context, ambiguous, or unemitted sites remain unscored in the reference denominator.
definitions.renaming: Procedure names remain exact. The frozen matcher alone accepts output variable renaming through unique producer addresses; lexical mismatch itself need not be semantically wrong.
